results.title: Tap a friend: their profile
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader, tapping a friend in Friends opens Profile with their picture and name, and their description or 'This person hasn't set up their profile yet.'; Close shuts it

results.title: Invite a friend by email
results.checks: Signed in as Seed Reader, Add a friend with an email address reads Send invitation; sending says 'Invitation sent to …' with no Home window, and Sent requests shows the address as Invited by email with Resend and Cancel; Resend says it was sent again; Cancel takes it off. (The invitation calls are answered by the test, so no email goes out; each carries the reader's sign-in)
results.note: 'flow-150611@example.org': Invitation sent; listed as Invited by email; Resend said sent again; Cancel took it off; no Home window

results.title: An emailed invitation opens in the reader
results.checks: The link /invite/<token> opens the reader with 'Ruth wants to be friends' and Ruth's note, and, signed out, Sign in to accept; a dead link says 'This invitation can't be opened'; signed in, Add Ruth as a friend takes the invitation (the Home is told) and opens the Home for the signature. (The invitation calls are answered by the test)
results.note: a dead link: can't be opened; Ruth's invitation with her note and Sign in to accept; signed in, Add took it and opened the Home to add Ruth
